about_the_game:
A collection of camouflage pattern spray paints that grant your weapon a unique personal mark while ensuring tactical concealment.

This expansion includes 10 weapon customization spray paints and item purchase authorizations from merchant(s).

Pack Includes:

  • Spray Paints:

    • Jungle Camo 1 (1 pcs.)

    • Jungle Camo 2 (1 pcs.)

    • Jungle Camo 3 (1 pcs.)

    • Mountain Camo 1 (1 pcs.)

    • Mountain Camo 2 (1 pcs.)

    • Desert Camo 1 (1 pcs.)

    • Desert Camo 2 (1 pcs.)

    • Current (1 pcs.)

    • Whimsical (1 pcs.)

    • Lush (1 pcs.)

  • Merchant Store(s)

    • Unlocks 'Jungle Camo 1' spray paint

    • Unlocks Jungle Camo 2' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Jungle Camo 3' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Mountain Camo 1' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Mountain Camo 2' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Desert Camo 1' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Desert Camo 2' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Current' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Whimsical' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Lush' spray paint

Spray paints can be applied to weapons at the Spray Painting Booth in the Hideout.

Items included in this DLC will be sent via in-game mails. Please check your mailbox after purchase to claim your items.

DLC contents will be reissued after each data reset, its actual content is subject to change in future updates.
